submittedPrompt: 制作一张清晰三分区对照板，外部只标桌面、390px、320px，表示三个独立视口中的同一窗口，不是同页同时打开。全部字段/按钮保持可读，窄屏自然换行，允许内部滚动，关闭和主动作可达。只画明确列出的窗口与文案，不加附注或父页导航。平面白/浅灰、深色字、细线、小圆角、#4566c6蓝色、清晰紧凑中文；不画设备外壳。每份白色局部弹窗相同：标题“编辑链接”、右上关闭X；准确3个纵排字段“显示文字”input参考链接；“链接地址”input https://example.invalid/guide；“标题”input参考资料。底部右侧“取消”和蓝色“保存链接”均可用。没有删除链接/打开链接/新建笔记/URL错误、只读警告或其他按钮。三个视口完整保留每个label和输入值，长URL在字段内正常裁切或内部滚动，不溢出整个窗口。

entry.trigger: 插入链接 / 编辑链接

permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

fields.name: 显示文字
fields.constraints: When empty, URL becomes display text.

fields.name: 链接地址
fields.constraints: Trimmed nonempty; no backslash or U+0000–0020; no protocol-relative //; allowed explicit schemes http,https,mailto,tel or relative/fragment URLs.

fields.name: 标题
fields.constraints: No additional client constraint found; server validation not otherwise verified.

actions.label: 保存链接
actions.guard: Editor writable/unblocked; captured revision still matches; safeEditorUrl required

actions.label: 取消
actions.guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.

responsive.behavior: Shared .dialog-card width/min viewport rules and mobile padding apply; exact fit, clipping and focus at target widths remain unverified (apps/web/style.css:783,1271).

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.
